verses.text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

segments.text: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.

verses.text: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?

segments.text: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?

verses.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

segments.text: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

segments.text: These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the festive procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.

verses.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

segments.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

verses.text: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.

segments.text: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.

verses.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

segments.text: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.

verses.text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

segments.text: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.text: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

segments.text: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”

verses.text: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

segments.text: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”

verses.text: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
